text:
maria.dev: FYI — reserved GPU reservation queue spiked overnight for us-east1. We're at 58 queued requests and the panel is reporting 9–12 day lead times for A100s. Can we discuss short-term rebalancing? :grimacing:

jason.ops: ugh. what's the breakdown? dev vs. prod? any big one-off requests?

maria.dev: mostly prod reserved requests (customer commits) and a few infra test bundles. quick snippet from the queue API:```
$ rctl reservations list --region us-east1 --status queued --json | jq 'length'
58
```

infra-bot: Reservation queue length for us-east1: 58 (A100-family). Oldest request age: 6d 3h.

kevin.sre: We could temporarily reassign 8 GPUs from the eu-west shared pool to us-east via the cross-region burst policy. Will add ~15% network egress/cost. Also need to check affinity constraints for Dedicated customers — can't move those.

jason.ops: do we have any reserved capacity commitments expiring soon that we can shuffle?

maria.dev: There's a 40-node reserved commit starting in 10 days (commit ID RC-2026-17) but nothing earlier. That's why queue backed up.

elaine.billing: If we shift capacity across regions we'll need a change in billing allocation. I can pre-approve up to $45k additional spend for next 30 days if ENG agrees to a temporary policy and we tag costs to "emergency-burst-us-east".

kevin.sre: ok. two options: 1) cold-migrate 8 nodes (manual, ~2h ops, impact minimal) 2) run short-term spot-to-reserved conversion where we convert queued spot requests into reserved on the customer's behalf with cost protection (requires billing sign-off). Option 2 avoids migration but increases committed spend.

maria.dev: preference for option 1 to avoid changing customer-facing invoices. Jason — can you run the migration plan? Steps roughly: remove nodes from eu-west pool, set cross-region routing, rehydrate model caches. I can own rollout and monitoring.

jason.ops: I can start the plan in the 02:00–04:00 UTC window to minimize traffic. Plan:```
- drain 2 nodes at a time
- rsync model caches or use cache prewarm script
- update topology service with new pool weights
- watch latency SLOs via console dashboards
```

scheduler-bot: Scheduled maintenance window created for 1779336000 (2026-03-21T02:00Z) — 03:00 UTC backup slot 1779339600. Operators: jason.ops, kevin.sre.

elaine.billing: tagging/approval noted. Please ensure cost tags in infra events so finance can reconcile. Also, open a quick PR to the reserved-cost ledger so we don't double-bill.

maria.dev: Will do. Also putting a hold on manual acceptance of new reserved requests for us-east until backlog drops below 12. I'll add a short notice to the reservation portal (customer-facing queue).

kevin.sre: after migration we'll run a 48h health check and then evaluate if we need to accelerate RC-2026-17 (move from 10d to 6d) — that'll cost ~12% extra. I'll draft an ops runbook.

jason.ops: Starting drain prep in 30m. Maria will post updates here. @kevin.sre @elaine.billing please ack if you see any blockers. :thumbsup:

elaine.billing: Ack. Finance ready to log spend once PR and tags are present.

kevin.sre: Ack. Logging: #INC-2026-331 (tracking migration and billing impact).

maria.dev: quick heads-up log entries:```
INC-2026-331: us-east1 reservation queue surge -> temporary eu-west->us-east burst migration. Owners: jason.ops/maria.dev. ETA: 4h. Cost tag: emergency-burst-us-east.
```

jason.ops: Update: started draining node eu-west-12. No errors yet. I'll post perf diffs after the first 2 nodes are live in us-east.

infra-bot: Node eu-west-12 drained -> reassigned -> us-east-03 added to pool. Queue length now 52.

maria.dev: nice. keep the updates coming. If we still have >20 queued after 12 hours we'll revisit customer-facing throttles.

elaine.billing: I've created PR #finance/942 to adjust the reserved ledger; please link it to INC-2026-331.

jason.ops: perf check after node move: p99 latency up 3%, throughput stable. Reverting if p99 > 10% baseline.

kevin.sre: good. continuing. We'll follow up with a post-mortem and cost breakdown once migration completes.

maria.dev: thanks all — closing the request for escalation for now, will reopen if any regression. :white_check_mark:
